title: Copilot Studio: discover and use shared plugins from Microsoft's plugin registry
summary: The roadmap facts, documented general controls and licensing background are supported. The discoverability statement needs narrowing to availability restrictions in the Copilot channel; it should not imply that every blocked plugin remains visible in every experience. Searches did not find documentation for the specific Copilot Studio registry connection.
